Assessment & Plan (Integrating DDx)

Key findings:  Young Indigenous adult female with new-onset suprapubic burning pain, urinary frequency, and pink urine without dysuria; mild systemic symptoms; no flank pain; bowels presently normal; Implanon in situ, pregnancy risk low but not excluded.

Working diagnosis:  Acute uncomplicated cystitis.

Differential diagnoses (from DDx and consistent with transcript)  
• Acute cystitis – High likelihood: characteristic suprapubic pain, frequency, hematuria, mild systemic features.  
• Early/atypical appendicitis – Moderate likelihood: infra-umbilical pain, nausea, subjective fever; will monitor for migration or worsening.  
• Ectopic pregnancy – Low-moderate likelihood: reproductive age, lower-abdominal pain; rule out with pregnancy test.

Plan:  Empiric oral Trimethoprim for 3 days; advise adequate fluids, cranberry juice, and paracetamol for pain.  Home urine pregnancy test today; formal urinalysis, urine culture, and further abdominal assessment if no improvement or deterioration.  Safety-net advice: seek review for worsening pain, persistent fever, vomiting, or positive pregnancy test.  Follow-up appointment in a few days or sooner if concerned.

Management Plan

- Antibiotic: Trimethoprim (strength not documented) 1 tablet twice daily × 3 days, prescription sent to pharmacy.  
- Analgesia: Paracetamol prn.  
- Hydration advice and cranberry juice suggestion.  
- Home urine pregnancy test recommended today; repeat or clinic test if uncertainty.  
- Return/review if symptoms not improving in 48–72 h or if red-flag symptoms develop.  
- Consider urine culture, pelvic ultrasound, and full blood count at review if not resolving.

Summary of Differential Diagnoses (from DDx):

1. Acute cystitis – High: suprapubic pain, urinary frequency, hematuria, mild systemic features.  
2. Acute appendicitis (early) – Moderate: infra-umbilical pain, gradual worsening, mild nausea/fever, but no RLQ localization yet.  
3. Ectopic pregnancy – Low-moderate: reproductive age, lower-abdominal pain; low risk with Implanon but must exclude with pregnancy test.
